+# Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on EvoScientist (2026-09-29)
+
+The raw run directories below are distributed as the matching `.tar.gz`
+archives in this directory. Extract an archive before inspecting its
+`result.json`, commands, metrics, and server logs or running the summary
+script. Negative and aborted trials are retained alongside the positive
+high-concurrency result.
+
+This directory keeps the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B measurements and the inputs needed to
+check them. The model ran on machine 91 with Ascend NPUs 2–5 (TP4), in the
+`vllm-hust-dev` Conda environment. The model weights are at
+`/workspace/models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B` on that machine. The BidKV checkout was
+`a0cba97d9abdc99908e46616db622f0e0099127f`; the benchmark checkout was
+`47c12e518a9188bb714bb6193d00260a7741841b`. The measured stack reported
+vLLM `0.28.1.post1.dev143+gf18cf803c.empty`, vLLM Ascend HUST
+`0.25.1rc2.dev125+hust.20260903.4.g74f0c0a27`, and BidKV `0.2.1`.
+The vLLM-HUST source base was `f18cf803c5f63625e2c71253ddaf8b0bad0bad1a`;
+the vLLM-Ascend-HUST source base was
+`249ac128cae3ddec51114f482262988b7b312a4a` plus the recorded build
+compatibility patch.
+`comparisons.csv`, generated by `scripts/summarize_qwen35_kv_pressure.py`,
+lists every complete paired run, including negative results and the number of
+active policy selections.
+The server was started without eager enforcement; its logs show
+`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` graph mode and completed PIECEWISE plus decode FULL graph
+capture. They also warn that `causal_conv1d_update` used a PyTorch fallback.
+
+The input comes from the benchmark repository's
+`scripts/traces/evoscientist-workload-custom.jsonl` subset. Its SHA-256 is
+`13347797c3660c5b3efbf8912bbcb76d8bba50ffee5f77944b95b9cde1b6ca3c`.
+The short mixed input contains source lines 21, 23, 25 and 31 (one-based), in
+that order; its SHA-256 is
+`c51108d1b850f4defea6c417272c3b25ccd71e42d759ea637627373a6e09cc30`.
+The ascending input contains the same four source lines in reverse order; its
+SHA-256 is
+`f06947bb8a6e25a6b1cc61c4f09718ce8f924bd041e7725a8369fbfa187374a4`.
+All exact JSONL inputs are copied into this directory.
+The short input requests 1,801, 1,118, 1,065 and 923 output tokens,
+respectively (4,907 in total).
+The high-concurrency input contains the first 12 original rows (24,148 output
+tokens), with SHA-256
+`53588fc1a06bbe59b6737b434a0664b58fd673a7dfe38a493749b3faed921d8d`.
+
+The website's `FRONTIER-QWEN35-UNIFIED-MODS.md` at commit `f64b1a7` reports
++0.25% as a geometric mean across five TP2 concurrency cells. Its coverage
+record says that BidKV had zero policy calls and zero preemptions in those
+cells, so this is not evidence of a victim-selection benefit. The tests here
+require nonzero policy calls and compare the exact same output-token totals.
+
+## Completed eight-request measurements
+
+All arms completed eight requests and generated the same 15,617 output tokens.
+The throughput metric is vLLM's `output_throughput` (generated tokens divided
+by benchmark duration). The runner uses `--custom-output-len -1` and
+`--ignore-eos` so each request generates the trace's requested token count.
+Each arm started a fresh server. The second pair
+reversed the arm order to expose time-dependent variation. The tuned first
+pair reuses the baseline from the default trial; the tuned BidKV arm was run
+after the default BidKV arm, so these are not consecutive paired runs.
+
+| Configuration and order | Baseline tok/s | BidKV tok/s | BidKV change | BidKV policy calls / selections / failures |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Default BidKV, baseline first | 27.211 | 24.454 | -10.13% | 1,134 / 227 / 0 |
+| `BIDKV_UTILITY_PREEMPT_WEIGHT=5.0`, baseline first | 27.211 | 28.635 | +5.24% | 1,014 / 32 / 0 |
+| Same setting, BidKV first | 31.960 | 29.161 | -8.76% | 1,014 / 32 / 0 |
+
+The +5.24% result **does not establish an advantage**: the reversed-order
+replication is negative. The baseline varied from 27.211 to 31.960 tok/s with
+the same input. Across the two tuned comparisons, BidKV averaged
+28.898 tok/s and baseline averaged 29.585 tok/s (-2.32%). All raw
+`result.json`, `metrics.txt`, server and benchmark logs,
+commands and NPU snapshots are preserved in the two extracted run directories.
+The original compressed snapshot is `core-results.tar.gz` (SHA-256
+`ddc270e295d7f15935139149cc430ba96924528a021d7dc82f52a9286997db97`).
+
+An earlier summary incorrectly included the Prometheus counter creation-time
+series in the first baseline's preemption count. The corrected count is 949;
+`summary-before-metric-correction.json` is retained for audit. This did not
+change throughput or output-token counts.
+
+## Short four-request measurements
+
+The short mixed input uses `--max-model-len 2048`, 256 MiB KV cache per NPU,
+concurrency 4, request rate 4, and `BIDKV_UTILITY_PREEMPT_WEIGHT=5.0`. Each arm
+completed 4/4 requests and generated the same 4,907 output tokens. These were
+two consecutive pairs with alternating order.
+
+| Run order | Baseline tok/s | BidKV tok/s | BidKV change | Preemptions baseline / BidKV | BidKV selections / failures |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Baseline then BidKV | 151.351 | 143.431 | -5.23% | 10 / 14 | 7 / 0 |
+| BidKV then baseline | 151.001 | 144.119 | -4.56% | 10 / 14 | 7 / 0 |
+
+BidKV was called 14 times in each run. This configuration is consistently
+worse than baseline. The logs show active selection of requests that were
+about 85–98% complete. The complete raw
+results are in `bidkv-qwen35-shortmixed4-256m-2048-20260929/`, with a
+compressed snapshot at `shortmixed4-256m-preempt5.tar.gz`.
+
+Increasing the completion penalty from 0.5 to 10 while keeping the preemption
+penalty at 5 reduced active selections from seven to three per run, but did
+not improve throughput:
+
+| Run order | Baseline tok/s | BidKV tok/s | BidKV change | Preemptions baseline / BidKV | BidKV selections / failures |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Baseline then BidKV | 153.580 | 141.650 | -7.77% | 10 / 15 | 3 / 0 |
+| BidKV then baseline | 152.639 | 141.692 | -7.17% | 10 / 15 | 3 / 0 |
+
+The raw results are in `bidkv-qwen35-shortmixed4-completion10-20260929/` and
+`shortmixed4-256m-completion10.tar.gz`. The next trial reverses the four
+requests into ascending output-length order, a scheduling pattern that
+[previous BidKV evidence](../../docs/evidence/sage-mate-20260905-bounded-preemption-matrix.md)
+found less harmful; it retains the preemption penalty
+of 5 and default completion penalty of 0.5.
+
+That ascending trial produced +0.80% and -1.96% in two alternating pairs.
+Both candidate arms had 10 policy calls and **zero active selections**; the
+baseline and candidate each had 10 preemptions. The positive run therefore
+cannot be attributed to BidKV's victim selection. All four arms completed
+4/4 requests and generated 4,907 tokens. Raw results are in
+`bidkv-qwen35-shortascending4-256m-20260929/` and
+`shortascending4-256m-preempt5.tar.gz`.
+
+## High-concurrency KV-pressure result
+
+The first 12 EvoScientist rows were run at concurrency 12, request rate 4,
+4,096 maximum model length and 512 MiB KV cache per NPU. BidKV used
+`BIDKV_UTILITY_PREEMPT_WEIGHT=5.0`. The four arms alternated order, each
+completed 12/12 requests, and each generated the same 24,148 output tokens.
+The cache was under pressure: baseline made 850 preemptions in each repeat.
+
+**Observed single-cell TP4 C12 output-throughput uplift: +13.88%**, the
+arithmetic mean of the two paired percentage changes below.
+
+| Run order | Baseline tok/s | BidKV tok/s | BidKV change | Preemptions baseline / BidKV | BidKV calls / selections / failures |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| Baseline then BidKV | 35.370 | 41.422 | +17.11% | 850 / 786 | 786 / 10 / 0 |
+| BidKV then baseline | 35.966 | 39.795 | +10.65% | 850 / 711 | 711 / 7 / 0 |
+
+Both repeats show active BidKV selections and lower preemption counts, so this
+is a measured benefit in this tested cell rather than a zero-call difference.
+Two pairs do not establish a confidence interval or generalize to other
+workloads. Every arm's log records `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` and completed decode
+FULL graph capture.
+The second BidKV server emitted an `EngineDeadError` in its output handler
+while shutting down **after** the benchmark result and metrics had been saved;
+the benchmark itself completed and its policy failure counter was zero.
+
+Raw commands, `result.json`, Prometheus metrics, server logs and NPU snapshots
+are in `bidkv-qwen35-evoscientist-first12-c12-512m-20260929/`. The exact
+compressed snapshot is `first12-c12-512m-preempt5.tar.gz` (SHA-256
+`a9d3889bb195fa3be913b9201145c86ff17ffb702a0a8bcd51d6f8fcaa4a46e9`).
+
+## Reproduction
+
+From `/workspace/vllm-hust-bidkv`, after installing the repository into
+`vllm-hust-dev`, use
+`scripts/run_qwen35_kv_pressure.py`. For example, the tuned eight-request pair
+can be run with:
+
+```bash
+conda run -n vllm-hust-dev python scripts/run_qwen35_kv_pressure.py \
+  --model /workspace/models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B \
+  --devices 2,3,4,5 \
+  --trace results/qwen35-evoscientist-20260929/evoscientist-workload-custom.jsonl \
+  --output-dir /workspace/qwen35-evoscientist-preempt5-reproduction \
+  --num-prompts 8 --max-concurrency 8 --request-rate 4 \
+  --max-model-len 8192 --kv-cache-memory-bytes 268435456 \
+  --candidate-config '{"utility_preempt_weight":5.0}' --repeats 2
+```
+
+The positive high-concurrency cell used:
+
+```bash
+conda run -n vllm-hust-dev python scripts/run_qwen35_kv_pressure.py \
+  --model /workspace/models/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B \
+  --devices 2,3,4,5 \
+  --trace results/qwen35-evoscientist-20260929/evoscientist-first12.jsonl \
+  --output-dir /workspace/qwen35-first12-c12-512m-reproduction \
+  --num-prompts 12 --max-concurrency 12 --request-rate 4 \
+  --max-model-len 4096 --kv-cache-memory-bytes 536870912 \
+  --candidate-config '{"utility_preempt_weight":5.0}' --repeats 2
+```
+
+For the short four-request trial, change the trace to
+`evoscientist-short-mixed-4.jsonl` in this directory and use
+`--num-prompts 4 --max-concurrency 4 --max-model-len 2048` with the same
+256 MiB KV setting. The follow-up also sets
+`"utility_completion_weight":10.0` in `--candidate-config`.
+
+The script checks model shards, saves exact commands and provenance, alternates
+arm order, requires complete requests and identical output-token totals, and
+verifies that the BidKV selector was called without policy failures. The
+working vLLM-Ascend-HUST installation required a compiled native extension;
+`ascend-build-compat.patch.gz` records the source compatibility changes used to
+build it for this environment.
+
+The 96 MiB KV-cache trial on the short input was stopped before it could yield
+any complete comparison. In its first baseline arm the cache remained at 100%,
+three of four requests waited, and generation fell to about 2 tok/s. That
+configuration is excluded from throughput comparisons; its logs are retained
+in `shortmixed4-96m-aborted.tar.gz`. A 256 MiB trial on the same short input
+was then completed, as reported above.

+"""Download one pinned Qwen3.5-35B-A3B snapshot from ModelScope with checksums.
+
+Use an HF tree manifest for file sizes and LFS SHA-256 hashes. ModelScope serves
+the same Qwen snapshot on machines where Hugging Face's weight CDN is blocked.
+The downloader resumes partial files and verifies every completed file.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import concurrent.futures
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import quote
+
+
+MODEL_URL = "https://modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B/resolve/master"
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def git_blob_sha1(path: Path, size: int) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha1(f"blob {size}\0".encode())
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(8 * 1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(block)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def download(entry: dict, target: Path) -> str:
+    relative = entry["path"]
+    size = int(entry["size"])
+    digest = entry.get("lfs", {}).get("oid")
+    blob_oid = entry.get("oid") if digest is None else None
+    target_path = target / relative
+    target_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if target_path.exists() and target_path.stat().st_size == size:
+        if (digest is not None and sha256_file(target_path) == digest) or (
+            blob_oid is not None and git_blob_sha1(target_path, size) == blob_oid
+        ):
+            return f"verified {relative}"
+
+    partial = target_path.with_name(target_path.name + ".part")
+    if partial.exists() and partial.stat().st_size > size:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"partial file larger than expected: {partial}")
+    url = f"{MODEL_URL}/{quote(relative, safe='/')}"
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    for key in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy"):
+        env.pop(key, None)
+    command = [
+        "curl", "--noproxy", "*", "--fail", "--location", "--silent", "--show-error",
+        "--retry", "8", "--retry-delay", "3", "--connect-timeout", "20",
+        "--speed-limit", "1024", "--speed-time", "120",
+        "--continue-at", "-", "--output", str(partial), url,
+    ]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"download failed for {relative}: {result.stderr[-500:]}")
+    actual_size = partial.stat().st_size
+    if actual_size != size:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"size mismatch for {relative}: {actual_size} != {size}")
+    if digest is not None:
+        actual_digest = sha256_file(partial)
+        if actual_digest != digest:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"checksum mismatch for {relative}: {actual_digest} != {digest}")
+    elif blob_oid is not None:
+        actual_oid = git_blob_sha1(partial, size)
+        if actual_oid != blob_oid:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"blob mismatch for {relative}: {actual_oid} != {blob_oid}")
+    partial.replace(target_path)
+    return f"downloaded {relative} ({size} bytes)"
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=8)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.workers < 1:
+        parser.error("workers must be positive")
+    entries = json.loads(args.manifest.read_text())
+    if not isinstance(entries, list) or not entries:
+        parser.error("manifest must be a nonempty HF tree list")
+    args.target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    failures = []
+    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as executor:
+        futures = [executor.submit(download, entry, args.target) for entry in entries]
+        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
+            try:
+                print(future.result(), flush=True)
+            except Exception as error:
+                failures.append(str(error))
+                print(f"ERROR {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+    if failures:
+        raise SystemExit(f"{len(failures)} download(s) failed")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+Example:

+    --model /path/to/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B --devices 0,1,2,3 \
+    --output-dir /workspace/bidkv-qwen35-results

+The script starts a fresh server for each arm, preserves raw results and logs,
+and reports policy activity so a throughput delta cannot be mistaken for an
+effective BidKV run when the selector was never called.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse

+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+POLICY = "bidkv.adapters.vllm_hust.selector.BidkvPreemptionPolicy"
+POLICY_ENV = {
+    "enable_utility_victim_selection": "BIDKV_UTILITY_ENABLE",
+    "utility_strategy": "BIDKV_UTILITY_STRATEGY",
+    "utility_kill_switch": "BIDKV_UTILITY_KILL_SWITCH",

+
+
+def http_get(url: str, timeout: float = 3) -> bytes:
+    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
+    with opener.open(url, timeout=timeout) as response:
+        return response.read()
+
+
+def wait_for_server(process: subprocess.Popen, port: int, timeout: int) -> None:
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        if process.poll() is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"server exited during startup: {process.returncode}")
+        try:
+            http_get(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health")
+            return
+        except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError):
+            time.sleep(2)
+    raise TimeoutError(f"server did not become healthy within {timeout}s")
+
+
+def stop_server(process: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
+    if process.poll() is not None:
+        return
+    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+    try:
+        process.wait(timeout=30)
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        process.wait()
+
+
+def metric_value(metrics: str, name: str, event: str | None = None) -> float:
+    values = []
+    for line in metrics.splitlines():
+        if not (line.startswith(f"{name}{{") or line.startswith(f"{name} ")):
+            continue
+        if event is not None and f'event="{event}"' not in line:
+            continue
+        match = re.search(r"\s([-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)$", line)
+        if match:
+            values.append(float(match.group(1)))
+    return sum(values)
+
+
+def git_head(path: Path) -> str | None:
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "-C", str(path), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False,
+    )
+    return result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else None

+"""Print a CSV of every complete paired Qwen3.5 KV-pressure run.
+
+Example:
+  python scripts/summarize_qwen35_kv_pressure.py \
+    results/qwen35-evoscientist-20260929 > comparisons.csv
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+FIELDS = (
+    "run",
+    "repeat",
+    "baseline_tps",
+    "bidkv_tps",
+    "delta_pct",
+    "completed",
+    "output_tokens",
+    "baseline_preemptions",
+    "bidkv_preemptions",
+    "policy_calls",
+    "policy_selections",
+    "policy_failures",
+)
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("results_dir", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    writer = csv.DictWriter(sys.stdout, fieldnames=FIELDS, lineterminator="\n")
+    writer.writeheader()
+
+    for summary_path in sorted(args.results_dir.glob("bidkv-*/summary.json")):
+        records = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
+        for repeat in sorted({row["repeat"] for row in records}):
+            pair = {row["arm"]: row for row in records if row["repeat"] == repeat}
+            if set(pair) != {"baseline", "bidkv"}:
+                continue
+            baseline, bidkv = pair["baseline"], pair["bidkv"]
+            if baseline["dataset_sha256"] != bidkv["dataset_sha256"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"{summary_path}: repeat {repeat} used different inputs")
+            for key in ("completed", "total_output_tokens"):
+                if baseline[key] != bidkv[key]:
+                    raise ValueError(f"{summary_path}: repeat {repeat} differs in {key}")
+            if bidkv["policy_calls"] <= 0 or bidkv["policy_failures"]:
+                raise ValueError(f"{summary_path}: repeat {repeat} has invalid policy activity")
+            writer.writerow(
+                {
+                    "run": summary_path.parent.name,
+                    "repeat": repeat,
+                    "baseline_tps": baseline["output_throughput"],
+                    "bidkv_tps": bidkv["output_throughput"],
+                    "delta_pct": 100
+                    * (bidkv["output_throughput"] / baseline["output_throughput"] - 1),
+                    "completed": baseline["completed"],
+                    "output_tokens": baseline["total_output_tokens"],
+                    "baseline_preemptions": baseline["preemptions"],
+                    "bidkv_preemptions": bidkv["preemptions"],
+                    "policy_calls": bidkv["policy_calls"],
+                    "policy_selections": bidkv["policy_selections"],
+                    "policy_failures": bidkv["policy_failures"],
+                }
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
